B_cap_hit_audit.question: Why are cap-hit rates 14-44% against the preregistered <=10% gate?
B_cap_hit_audit.definition_checked: cap = max(1, 0.25*|B0p|); capped iff |raw ridge correction z| > cap (z = icpt + sum(standardized feature * coef), target = actual - B0p). Matches prereg.
B_cap_hit_audit.coding_defect: NONE. Independent R re-implementation (closed-form ridge, same FIT filter) reproduces the harness cap-hit exactly: WR RL 0.1414 vs 0.14139; QB RL 0.1892 vs 0.18924.
B_cap_hit_audit.intercept_or_normalization_artifact: NO. Removing the intercept leaves cap-hit unchanged or higher (e.g. TE RL 0.337 -> 0.307 only; RB RL 0.214 -> 0.249; WR RL 0.141 -> 0.192).
B_cap_hit_audit.population_mismatch: CONTRIBUTING but not causal for cap-hit: FIT rows contain 0.6-10% actual==0 rows while VAL rows contain 18.5-22.5% (healthy scratches / inactive non-OUT players). Cap-hit among PLAYED rows is nearly as high as overall (QB 0.143 / RB 0.214 / WR 0.130 / TE 0.331 for RL), so it is not driven by DNP rows.
B_cap_hit_audit.sparse_role_evidence: NO. By player-games bucket the rate is flat (QB: 0.172 at 4-9 games; n<4 rows are 19 of 576); hits do not concentrate where Role evidence is thin.
B_cap_hit_audit.legitimate_behaviour: YES - the dominant cause. Hits concentrate in LOW-B0p cells where the cap floor is the absolute 1.0 point: QB b0<6: 94-100%, b0 6-10: 70-77%, b0>=10: 3-20%; RB b0<6: 35-60%; WR b0<6: 27-35%. The ridge correction is a few points wide for low-baseline players (the baseline is a poor predictor there) so it frequently exceeds 1.0/25%. The correction is also asymmetric: upward hits dominate for QB/RB/WR.
B_cap_hit_audit.cap_not_tuned: The cap is NOT raised, removed or tuned. No fix was legitimate, so there is no before/after: before == after.
B_cap_hit_audit.verdict: Every candidate that exceeds 10% cap-hit FAILS the preregistered cap gate. They remain failed. Cap-hit is reported for every candidate at final scoring.

C_bias_conditioning.finding: The preregistered forecasts are CONDITIONAL-ON-ACTIVE point forecasts (B0p, source_semantics CONDITIONAL_ON_ACTIVE) with the canonical injury model (evaluateInjuryModel, injury-expected-value-2026.1) applied exactly once. VAL/FINAL rows additionally contain 18.5-22.5% actual==0 rows (non-designated inactives / scratches) that NO availability authority predicts. This mismatch makes |bias|<=0.5 structurally unreachable for the CHAMPION too (B1p bias -1.1 .. -2.4).

population_labels.ORIGINAL_CONFIRMATORY: bias / MAE on ALL gate rows (including actual==0 rows) - the preregistered T4 gate. UNCHANGED. Candidates fail T4 at every position, as the champion does.
population_labels.PIPELINE_CORRECTED_CONFIRMATORY: NOT DEFENSIBLE. The evaluated pipeline already is (conditional forecast x canonical availability applied once). A further availability correction would require a NEW availability model (forbidden) or actual participation as a pregame feature (leakage). No pipeline-corrected confirmatory metric exists.
population_labels.CONDITIONAL_ON_PLAY_DIAGNOSTIC: bias / MAE restricted to rows with actual>0. DIAGNOSTIC ONLY: it conditions on the outcome and cannot support a qualification claim. It is reported beside the original metric.

C_bias_conditioning.diagnostic_finding: Even conditional on play, the candidate layers carry a POSITIVE bias of +0.1..+0.75 points (RL/G1/G2) against ~0 for the champion B1p: the correction layers are not bias-clean. FIT target contamination: FIT mean(actual - B0p) = -0.14 QB, -0.47 RB, -0.59 WR, -0.49 TE, of which only -0.09/-0.37/-0.15/-0.00 remains on played rows (the rest is DNP rows inside FIT). This is recorded, not repaired (no refit).

availability_applied_exactly_once.numeric_proof: for every applicable VAL row, expected == inj(b0 + delta) to 0.0 (single application); designation-NONE rows deviate from the undiscounted value by <=0.005 (rounding only); on discounted rows a second application would differ by >=0.15 pts (min) - so no double discount.
availability_applied_exactly_once.structural_proof: scripts/w2r1/s5_run.ts calls evaluateInjuryModel in exactly one helper (inj), and the delta is added BEFORE that single call (tested in test/w2r1-freeze.test.ts); mutants W9, W25, W48 kill second-application variants.

materiality_rule.rule_text: A league's D/ST is EXACT_SCORING_QUALIFIED only if every non-zero key is reconstructed / mapped-equivalent / not-applicable, any unreconstructable key is quantified immaterial (<0.05 pts/team-game; league total <0.10), and the end-to-end mean absolute error of reconstructed actual points vs provider-stat-line-implied points is <=0.25. Otherwise DIAGNOSTIC ONLY. Fixed before final access; not tuned to results.

D_kdst_scoring.unknown_components_never_scored_as_zero: Bloodline blk_kick_ret_yd (0.04/yd) and fg_ret_yd (0.04/yd): not reconstructable from nflverse; provider actuals imply 0.0157 pts/team-game combined (immaterial, < 0.05 each and < 0.10 total) - recorded as UNKNOWN_BOUNDED in the coverage artifact; Bloodline D/ST carries EXACT_SCORING_QUALIFIED_BOUNDED_RESIDUAL, never plain exact.
